reason: I might take the free call and look at the 15 companies, since that costs me nothing, but signing a pilot with an agency that found me on LinkedIn is not something I do in a month. My partner will ask who else in wholesale they have done this for, and one logistics client with 45 meetings is not an answer.
objection: I get three or four of these pitches a week. 'Qualified meeting' sounds clean on paper, but I worry I end up arguing every week about whether a meeting counts, and at EUR 350 each, ten meetings is EUR 3,500 for talks that may never turn into an order.
would_change_my_mind: A wholesaler or distributor like us, in the market we want to enter, who will talk to me on the phone and say the meetings turned into real orders.
